$comment: Golden match definitions for the determinism gate.
08-API-SURFACE.md /health. CI runs every matchup on every PR and asserts
output_sha256 matches the value recorded in simulator/test/fixtures/.
The `hash` field is deliberately null. It is populated by the first
deterministic run (Phase 14 task T16.3) and committed. A hash that
changes without a sim_version bump fails the build; a hash that is
edited by hand to make a build pass is the failure mode this file
cannot prevent, so the fixtures are reviewed like source.
Before these hashes exist, no match may be described by a win rate.
